title: US Market: Rising US debt, inflation keep pressure on long-term Treasury yields - The Economic Times
text:
US Treasury yields rose as investors remained concerned about rising government debt, persistent inflation and higher borrowing costs. A larger-than-expected $6 billion Treasury buyback failed to reassure markets, with long-term yields climbing to multi-week highs. Investors remain focused on fiscal deficits, bond supply and the sustainability of demand for longer-dated Treasuries.
